rows.mappingNote: New article for 強気 つよき 1236230:1-2; confidence/firmness and bullish market stance.
rows.sourceNote: Separate the actual つよき heading from unrelated ごうぎ/ごうき homographs. Mental stance is not unrestricted physical strength; bullishness is an expectation, not a successful prediction.

source.waller_definition: to balance,to be in harmony,to suit

rows.mappingNote: New intransitive godan article for balance/equilibrium and being a suitable match, 1434050:1-2.
rows.sourceNote: Preserve native construction and whole reading; the fishing character association does not mean fishing together. Suitable proportion need not be identity.

rows.mappingNote: New article for transitive suspension 1434020:1, not the extant homophone 釣る 1434120.
rows.sourceNote: Selected hanging sense is godan/transitive. Full family also includes specialized and intransitive uses; do not universalize the selected POS or transfer all mixed public-heading senses to this spelling.

rows.mappingNote: Raw 吊す maps to explicit same-family alias recognition in the new primary 吊るす article, 1433980:1.
rows.sourceNote: Both spellings accept つるす. Raw 吊す endpoint yielded no SGKDJ body and is not positive evidence; separately captured and read canonical 吊るす has the actual lexical definition and examples.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse stable 出会い with explicit 出合い であい encounter-alias recognition, 1338400:1-2; preserve N3 and primary identity.
rows.sourceNote: Add substantive 合 variant link without changing primary kanji metadata. Do not claim confluence sense3 as selected encounter coverage or re-adjudicate the unchanged 出会う exclusion.

rows.mappingNote: New article for washing hands/basin, restroom, and laundering by hand, 1328020:1-3.
rows.sourceNote: Distinguish what is washed from the means of washing. Actual public definition supports する despite noun-only principal labels; polite お手洗い gives the restroom construction.

source.waller_definition: fixed number of regular personnel,capacity (of boat, etc.)

rows.mappingNote: New prescribed-headcount/capacity article, 1435400:1-2.
rows.sourceNote: Distinguish established capacity or complement from actual attendance and generic 人数/数. No existing 人数 or 満員 article was fabricated.

rows.mappingNote: New established/list/regular-price article, 1435410:1.
rows.sourceNote: A list price can differ from actual discounted payment. Compare actual price/cost meanings, not the homophone 低下 solely because of its reading.

rows.mappingNote: New decline/lowering/deterioration article with intransitive する, 1434250:1.
rows.sourceNote: Distinguish level/quality change from quantity and deliberate reduction; explain causative 低下させる. Add reciprocal 低/低下 at the actual reading ていか.

rows.mappingNote: New commuter/season-pass article, 1435510:1; abbreviation cross-reference to complete 1943110:1.
rows.sourceNote: Actual 定期乗車券 public body defines fixed period/section and repeated travel; compare inspected 回数券 rather than inventing unlimited validity or paper/electronic categories. Add 券 reciprocity.

rows.mappingNote: New regularly designated closing-day/day-off article, 1435540:1.
rows.sourceNote: Thin principal public heading points to 定休; separately captured complete 定休 body and 1854460:1 support the established business closure schedule. Do not equate it with the public-holiday calendar.

rows.mappingNote: New stopping/cessation/suspension and license/payment-suspension article, 1434920:1-3.
rows.sourceNote: Teach transitive and intransitive patterns. The archaic mourning sense4 is restricted to ちょうじ and is not an ordinary ていし use. Add reciprocal 停/停止.

rows.mappingNote: New article for a vehicle stopping, 1434960:1.
rows.sourceNote: Examples make the vehicle the stopping subject. JMdict's intransitive label is not a universal ban: actual public definition also records stopping a vehicle transitively. No traffic-law duration claim is made. Add 停 reciprocity.

rows.mappingNote: New power-outage article with intransitive する, 1435020:1.
rows.sourceNote: Planned and unexpected interruptions fit; an individual broken appliance does not necessarily establish a supply outage. Water outage is distinct. Add 停 reciprocity.

rows.mappingNote: New でいり article for movement, regular visits/dealings, receipts/payments and numerical fluctuation, 1339910:1-4.
rows.sourceNote: The でいり reading is restricted to 出入り in the pinned family; 出入 must not inherit it merely as another spelling. Do not turn raw freedom/access gloss wording into an unrestricted access-rights rule.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse stable 出入口 でいりぐち 1598540:1 and add sourced N2; retain primary reading/title/kanji and existing identity.

rows.sourceNote: Additional police-raid sense2 is named separately, not independently assigned N2. Maintenance may prevent damage but does not encompass every repair; compare actual care/servicing articles.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-only theme/topic/subject article, 1078830:1.
rows.sourceNote: Actual JMdict loan-source record is German Thema; separate unrelated public Tema heading. Search-only テマ is not promoted to the assigned reading. A theme is not necessarily the title.

sourceAccessLimits: All six original complete-family chunks123/297, nine original full-old-body chunks74,223 original labels,13 support complete families61 senses and ten support full old bodies actually read through EOF. Additional labels were read in full-body front matter.

Twenty source principal families42 senses are included in the136-family/358-sense union, not added to it. Selected/additional one-based senses are scoped author decisions, not independent level assignments.
All30 complete component records and complete 低/券/停 kanji bodies actually read. Missing 逢/価/遭/吊/釣/這 cards are not fabricated; written characters remain in word metadata.

Twenty-three endpoint attempts yielded22 positive lexical captures from one dictionary service, not22 independent dictionaries or fresh reviewer retrievals. Raw 吊す yielded no SGKDJ body; canonical 吊るす has a separate positive capture.

定休日 has a thin cross-reference body; actual separately captured 定休 supplies the business-closure definition. 定期乗車券 supplies the abbreviation and period/section conditions. Mixed headings and unequal source depth remain explicit.

Seventeen new articles and three narrow reuses. Preserve N3 出会い and N5 出かける primary identities and teaching; 出入口 gains sourcedN2 and a bounded correction to single-door exclusivity. All baseline exclusion lists remain unchanged.
出会い's original 出会う guard is preserved, not claimed as newly adjudicated. No blanket noun/verb exemption or transitive closure is assumed for new quiz comparisons.
Author actual inspection and checks, not independent findings, measured frequency, native-speaker certification, exhaustive dictionary coverage or a live-quiz guarantee.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive hypotheses, not independent findings or live-runtime guarantees. Read actual labels and complete ordinary senses for excesses and omissions; no blanket noun/verb exemptions.
強気 mental firmness and market stance,釣り合う balance and matching, and吊る/吊るす hanging require whole-family comparisons. Homophony with釣る or定価/低下 does not alone establish ambiguity.
手洗い has handwashing/restroom/hand-laundering senses;定員 concerns prescribed headcount rather than current attendance;定価 differs from discounted payment while retaining price overlap.
停止 general stoppage/suspension must be assessed directly against narrower stopping words,停車,停電 and断水, not as a transitive clique among those specializations.
出入り money/fluctuation and手入れ actual maintenance/repair plus police-raid recognition need ordinary-secondary-sense checks. 出来上がり is a noun, but actual completion/result overlaps are still considered.
定期券 is not every reusable travel card;定休日 is not every holiday;テーマ is not necessarily a title. Retained reused guards have not been redesigned.
